prompt: Create one original quiet-luxury logo concept for EDUJA on a pure white square inspection background. Route: Jewel Tusk. Design a sparse abstract mark using two opposing crescent cuts and one central vertical stroke; together they should imply elephant tusks and trunk without showing a face. The overall silhouette should resemble a cut gemstone or precisely folded metal, but remain completely flat and vector-like. Use solid obsidian #111718 as the main mark, deep teal #006266 for one plane, and a tiny muted antique-gold #B79A55 notch. Add an elegant bespoke uppercase EDUJA wordmark below, contemporary high-contrast sans, wide tracking. No gradients, shadows, 3D, metallic texture, mockup, crown, lotus, crest, religious imagery, book, graduation cap, or tagline. Render one centered logo only, on white, and save the completed result as a local PNG artifact for a review board.
title: Jewel Tusk
